This diff-grounded change means non-calendar references created by that block will no longer persist the integration credential id, while a later mapping block still records `credentialId: result.credentialId ?? undefined`, creating inconsistent reference shapes and plausibly breaking any downstream logic that relies on reference.credentialId for non-calendar integrations.
